description:
Settings screen (owner request 2026-11-11b section 3: the user picks
the preview render resolution): a "Preview quality" ListItem plus a
Low/Balanced/High SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow (DESIGN.md Inputs:
segmented buttons for a choice). Each button shows its label and its
playback/scrub dims ("%1$d / %2$d px") in tabular numerals (DESIGN.md
Numbers) so the tradeoff is visible, not just named. The supporting
body states the contract: the picker changes ONLY playback and
scrubbing - paused frames always sharpen to the clip's own resolution.

The screen owns no store: the level and the change callback are
parameters with defaults, so every existing caller (and the parameter-
less default) keeps working.

Wiring (AppNav): PreviewQualityStore joins the Stores holder, the
level is a remember { mutableStateOf } refreshed on change (same shape
as the preset entries), the picker persists through
